feed.title: JARMlab
feed.subtitle: We study how transcription factors read the genome and how non-coding genetic variants disrupt that reading to cause cardiovascular disease. Using biochemistry, high-throughput sequencing, and machine learning, we decode the regulatory logic of the cardiac genome.
